args.text:
Fixed-limit hold'em strategy (A03):
1. Play tight from early position: strong pairs (TT+), AK, AQ, AJs, KQs. Widen from late position (button/cutoff): suited connectors, medium pairs, suited aces, broadway.
2. Raise or re-raise strong hands preflop and on the flop to build pots; avoid bloating pots with marginal hands out of position.
3. Post-flop: bet when you have top pair or better or a strong draw; check-fold weak made hands to aggression; call with draws getting proper pot odds.
4. Fold to large re-raises without a strong hand. Don't bluff into multiple opponents.
5. Watch opponents: note who raises loosely, who folds to pressure, who calls too much. Exploit calling stations with value bets, bluff tight players who fold to aggression.
6. After each game, record which opponent tendencies were confirmed.
